name: Ane Loop ☆ Kyuuketsuki na Imouto wa Docchi no Onee-chan o Erandara Ii no~!?
original_name: 姉ループ☆吸血鬼な妹はどっちのお姉ちゃんを選んだらいいの～！？
source: Riko Riko, a high school student and vampire, lives her life being taken care of by her sister Aru, who is also a vampire. Riko thought that her peaceful life with Aru would last forever, but suddenly a mysterious second sister comes to Riko's house...!
translation: 莉子 莉子是一名高中生，也是一名吸血鬼，她的生活受到她也是吸血鬼的妹妹阿鲁的照顾。莉子以为自己和阿鲁的平静生活会永远持续下去，但突然，一个神秘的二姐来到了莉子家……！
